note: Set B is superior because it captures critical engineering entities missing in Set A, specifically the footing diameter (28") and the HSS stiffener section (HSS4X4X1/4). Set B also correctly distinguishes between the 14-gauge (Detail A5) and 16-gauge (Detail B5) deck plates, whereas Set A conflates them (applying a 16-gauge quote to a general deck opening claim). Set A misbinds the fitted stiffener dimension as 1 1/4" (which is a gap/offset) instead of its section PL5X3/8. Both sets have redundancy, but Set B is more comprehensive and accurate on component specifications.
